page_title: NIC 8-0 ETI | Nice v St Etienne 20/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Victor Orakpo (Nice) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
90+1' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
86' 8 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Pablo Rosario (Nice) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Gautier Larsonneur no chance!
86' Pablo Rosario (Nice) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
86' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Nice!
86' There's a break in play and referee Thomas Leonard must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Nice using VAR. This could be interesting!
85' PENALTY APPEAL by Nice, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
84' Sofiane Diop (Nice) will take a corner kick.
80' Sofiane Diop (Nice) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
77' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Victor Orakpo (Nice) replaces Mohamed-Ali Cho.
75' 7 - 0 Goal! 7:0. Sofiane Diop (Nice) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
74' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
71' Substitution. Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mathieu Cafaro walks off.
71' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Melvin Bard will be replaced by Ali Abdi (Nice).
71' The substitution is prepared. Tom Louchet (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan Clauss.

71' What a great touch by Benjamin Old (St Etienne)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
68' Great interplay ends with Zuriko Davitashvili playing a simple pass to Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne), who steadies himself and curls a shot from mid-range agonisingly wide of the left post.
66' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' Substitution. Youssoufa Moukoko walks off the pitch and Sofiane Diop (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
57' A snap shot by Badredine Bouanani (Nice) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Gautier Larsonneur produces a good save to thwart him.
56' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails painfully wide of the right post. What a great effort!
53' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) trips an opposition player and Thomas Leonard signals a foul. St Etienne earn a free kick.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nice are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
50' The corner from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is intercepted by Marcin Bulka.
49' Moise Bombito (Nice) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
49' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
49' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Nice earn a corner.
46' The game is over for Evann Guessand (Nice). Badredine Bouanani comes on for the second half.
46' Olivier Dall'Oglio prepares a substitution. Lucas Stassin is replaced by Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne).
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Leonard starts the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The opposition back off Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
45+4' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to find Evann Guessand, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45+3' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
39' 6 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice) was set free in the area by Evann Guessand and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 6:0.

36' 5 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Evann Guessand (Nice) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 5:0. Gautier Larsonneur was helpless.
36' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierre Cornud leaves the pitch and Leo Petrot (St Etienne) comes on.
35' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Aimen Moueffek and he is replaced by Mickael Nade (St Etienne).
35' The game has come to an end for Mathis Amougou. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Benjamin Old (St Etienne).
34' Looks like Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
31' Great teamplay by St Etienne as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' 4 - 0 Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice) was in the right place to put the ball into the back of the net with his body. It's 4:0.

24' 3 - 0 The defending players give Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the left side of the target. Gautier Larsonneur was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 3:0.
22' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
20' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
17' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
17' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. St Etienne have been awarded a corner kick.
15' 68:32 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
10' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
7' 2 - 0 Goal! Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:0.
4' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
4' Nice enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Nice win a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Nice will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
